description: How a published daily value can be checked: whether it is final, and for a final day its manifest (every file it was computed from with its SHA-256, the factors in force, the calculation code's SHA-256 and the final values) and the command that recomputes it from the public files with the published code. Omit date for the latest day with a manifest.

date.description: The index day, YYYY-MM-DD (US Central for GPUs, UTC for companies).

name.description: A GPU or an AI company.

name: verify_price

published.description: The value as published for that day

status.description: verifiable: final, with a manifest; provisional: the day is not over; pending: final, its manifest comes with the next update; rebuilt_history: before manifests began; restated: final, as recomputed by a later method version (Token Price Index 2.0 recomputed every token day to 2026-10-27), with version 1's manifest for that day when it has one; no_value: nothing published that day

title: Check a published price
